bib.title: Training Language Models to Reason Efficiently
bib.venue: NeurIPS 2025 (39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems)

question: Can RL training of an already-trained large reasoning model reduce chain-of-thought length (inference cost) with little loss of accuracy, under a single tunable knob?
hypothesis: A reward that penalises the length of correct responses (per-prompt normalised, sigmoid-clipped) lets online RL trade tokens for accuracy smoothly, saving most on easy problems.
contributions: A reward 1{correct}(1 - alpha * sigmoid((len - mean)/std)) with per-prompt normalisation, trained with PPO + RLOO advantage
A family of models with varying efficiency from one hyperparameter alpha
Baselines (cutoff, rejection-sampling SFT, DPO, O1-Pruner) and ablations (advantage normalisation, base model)

method.summary: Starting from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B/7B, run online RL (PPO objective with RLOO leave-one-out advantage, OpenRLHF) on 3.2k numeric-answer math prompts with reward = correct * (1 - alpha*sigmoid(normalised length)), length normalised per prompt over correct rollouts. Evaluate tokens vs accuracy on GSM8K, MATH500, AIME2024, CommonSenseQA, Logical Deduction.
method.task: RL fine-tuning of reasoning models for token-efficient chain-of-thought

datasets.name: Numina Math subset (MATH, cn_k12, AIME, AoPS, Olympiad)
datasets.preprocessing: filtered to problems with a parseable numerical answer (proof questions removed)

training.objective: PPO clipped objective with RLOO advantage A = R(y_i) - mean of other n-1 returns, sequence-level advantage used per token; reward 1{y=y*}(1 - alpha*sigmoid((LEN - MEAN(x))/STD(x))), MEAN/STD per prompt over correct rollouts estimated online
training.batch_size: 32 prompts per iteration, 8 responses each, global batch size 128 (2 gradient steps per RL iteration)
training.hardware: 4 GH200 GPUs (1.5B); 8 GH200 across two nodes (7B); ZeRO-2 (1.5B), ZeRO-3 + activation checkpointing (7B)

other.base_model_ablation: Qwen2.5-3B, Countdown, alpha=0.1, 2048-token context, up to ~400 steps

inference.samples: pass rate@k averaged per prompt: k=1 GSM8K, k=3 MATH500, k=10 AIME2024; 3 training seeds
inference.prompting: Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}. Question: $QUESTION

other.parser: Qwen2.5-Math evaluation parser; CommonSenseQA and Logical Deduction k not stated

metrics.name: Pass rate@k / accuracy
metrics.definition: per-prompt average accuracy over k samples, averaged over dataset

metrics.name: Normalized accuracy / tokens
metrics.definition: relative to R1-Distilled model of same size, aggregated over 5 datasets

metrics.name: Faithfulness score
metrics.definition: E[1{CoT verbalizes hint} | answer without hint != h, answer with hint = h]; string match

baselines: Rejection sampling + SFT on shortest correct (8 samples/prompt; ~2,200 / ~2,500 valid; lr 5e-6)
eval.protocol: 3 seeds per alpha; mean +- std in appendix tables; no significance test
